instructions.purpose: Run a saved automation now on the user's request.

tool.name: automation-run
tool.description: Runs the saved automation and returns outcome, text or data, error, fetches, logs, and paused. Success stores the returned state; failure counts towards the automatic pause after three consecutive failures. A paused automation returns outcome unavailable without running.

usage_rules.rule: Use only for saved automations; use automation-preview for unsaved or changed scripts.
If paused is true, report that this failure paused the automation.

example.context: User says: "check the weather automation now"
